description.zh: 昆山腔由传入当地的南戏与昆山一带的语言、音乐和歌舞结合发展。后来明代的唱腔改革属于进一步发展。
description.en: Kunshan vocal style grew from southern theatre in interaction with local speech, music and dance. Later Ming vocal reforms mark another stage.

description.zh: 南戏经信江流入江西，在弋阳吸收地方语音与民间音乐，逐渐孕育出新的声腔。
description.en: Southern theatre travelled along the Xin River. In Yiyang it absorbed local speech and folk music, gradually developing a new vocal style.

label.zh: 清末民初，辛亥革命前后

description.zh: 高腔、昆腔、胡琴、弹戏与灯戏在同台演出中合流，形成今天川剧的多声腔格局。各声腔有各自更早的历史。
description.en: Five older vocal traditions converged on shared stages around the 1911 Revolution, forming the multi-style structure associated with Sichuan opera.

description.zh: 中国非遗网将其形成联系到关中的劝善调、民间音乐和方言。具体声腔源流仍有不同说法。
description.en: The national heritage account connects its formation with Guanzhong admonitory tunes, local music and dialect. The precise lineage remains debated.

description.zh: 蒲州梆子进入晋中，与当地秧歌和民间曲调结合成为中路梆子。晋剧之名较晚。
description.en: Puzhou bangzi entered central Shanxi and interacted with local yangge and tunes to form Zhonglu Bangzi. The name Jinju came later.

description.zh: 京剧由多种剧种逐步汇合，联合国教科文组织申报文本将成形放在19世纪中叶。1790年徽班进京是较早的背景事件。
description.en: Peking opera took shape through interaction among several genres. The UNESCO nomination places its formation in the mid-19th century. The arrival of Anhui troupes in 1790 was an earlier development.

description.zh: 冀东莲花落在唐山的城市舞台上经成兆才等人改编，逐渐成为评剧。
description.en: Eastern Hebei lianhualuo was adapted for Tangshan’s urban stage by Cheng Zhaocai and others, developing into Pingju.

description.zh: 嵊县的落地唱书吸收周边地方曲艺与戏曲，清末初步形成小歌班，后又在上海发展。
description.en: Late Qing small troupes in Shengxian grew from local storytelling and drew on nearby opera and narrative forms. The genre developed further in Shanghai.

description.zh: 黄梅地方戏约在嘉庆年间形成，随后在鄂东及周边传播，和皖地的传播与发展共同构成其历史。
description.en: A local theatre form emerged around the Jiaqing reign in Huangmei. Its spread through eastern Hubei and its subsequent development in Anhui are part of the longer history.

description.zh: 南宋成书的《东京梦华录》回记北宋汴京瓦舍中的影戏。这里标的是皮影戏的早期见证，各地方流派的形成时间另需考证。
description.en: The Southern Song memoir Dongjing Meng Hua Lu recalls shadow theatre in Northern Song Bianjing. This dates evidence for the wider art, while local lineages have their own histories.

description.zh: 音乐工作者从20世纪40年代起在左权搜集记录当地民歌。开花调的实际发源时间仍待考。
description.en: Music researchers began collecting local songs in Zuoquan in the 1940s. The origin of Kaihua tunes remains undetermined.

label.en: Jiajing to Longqing reigns of the Ming

description.zh: 太仓一带的丝竹合奏与昆曲班社、地方礼俗共同发展，是江南丝竹早期历史的一条线索。
description.en: Silk-and-bamboo ensembles in the Taicang area developed alongside Kunqu troupes and local ceremonial practice, one thread in the history of Jiangnan sizhu.

label.en: Early development across the Ming–Qing transition

name.en: Guangzhou and the Pearl River Delta

description.zh: 广东音乐在广府地区经历长期萌发和发展。这里标的是明清以来的早期阶段，后来的定型与传播持续到近代。
description.en: Guangdong music developed over a long period in the Cantonese-speaking region. This is an early stage, with consolidation and wider circulation continuing into modern times.

label.zh: 清乾隆二十八年已有存世谱本

description.zh: 现存谱本提供清代的可核实证据。关于它与唐宋音乐的渊源，可结合谱字和传统记述再判断。
description.en: The surviving manuscript gives verifiable Qing evidence. Proposed links with Tang and Song music can be assessed separately through notation and historical accounts.

label.en: Early connections to Song and Yuan repertories

description.zh: 南音在闽南长期融合发展，曲目保留宋元词曲、戏曲音乐的线索。这个时段用于观察曲目渊源，成形年代仍难定。
description.en: Nanyin developed over a long period in southern Fujian. Its repertory preserves links with Song and Yuan song and theatrical music. The date range reflects these connections, with formation still uncertain.

description.zh: 高邮一带的民歌样式在元明时期开始成形，后来的曲目包括劳动号子、情歌和生活歌。
description.en: This local song tradition began to take shape in the Yuan and Ming. Its repertory later included work, love and everyday songs.

label.zh: 至迟明末清初，苏州评话已形成
label.en: Suzhou pinghua had formed by the late Ming and early Qing

description.zh: 这个年代对应评弹中的苏州评话。评话以吴语讲说为主，弹词的唱腔和伴奏另有发展脉络。
description.en: The dating applies to Suzhou pinghua, the spoken storytelling branch. Suzhou tanci has its own history of singing and accompaniment.

description.zh: 东北大秧歌与传入的莲花落融合，形成用东北方音表演、兼有歌舞的曲艺。
description.en: Northeastern yangge and lianhualuo from outside the region combined into a form of song, dance and narration in Northeastern speech.

description.zh: 河间木板大鼓经艺人改革，逐步采用北京语音，吸收京剧技巧并扩充伴奏。
description.en: Performers reworked the Hejian drum-song tradition, adopting Beijing speech, drawing on opera techniques and expanding the accompaniment.

description.zh: 粤曲在广府说唱文化中逐步形成，曲目可吸收地方器乐曲并填词演唱。
description.en: Cantonese narrative song developed in the Cantonese-speaking region. Its repertory could adapt local instrumental pieces by adding sung words.

name.zh: 新疆卫拉特蒙古传唱区

description.zh: 史诗原本在卫拉特蒙古部传唱，17世纪伴随迁徙传播到更广地区。早期形成的具体年代仍有不同说法。
description.en: The epic circulated among Oirat Mongols and spread more widely with migration in the 17th century. Its date of formation remains debated.
